entities.name: Santi Pietro e Paolo d'Agrò
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Santi Pietro e Paolo d’Agrò is a church in Casalvecchio Siculo, in the Metropolitan City of Messina on Sicily (Italy). It is one of the foremost examples on Sicily of Norman architecture.
